persistence: One MiniSat object and assumption-independent learned clauses per source
One native HiGHS model with retained weight-independent core rows
Direct changeColsCost; explicit previous hitting-set MIP start
Source-bound checked witnesses and branching proofs can survive processes
excluded_claims: No claim of HiGHS branch-and-bound tree retention across weight changes
No proof export from native MiniSat/HiGHS enters the checked lower bank
No equivalence to optimized iMaxHS or commercial MaxHS implementation
Native solver state is resident only, not serializable by this adapter
No formal verification of the Python encoding/RUP/projection kernel
No claim that native IHS cores or raw optimum status become independent proofs
capability.negative_bridge: Fresh bounded Glucose3 full-CNF export; independent strict RUP check; paid Boolean objective-cut antichain projection
capability.api_source_note: Official current docs read 2026-10-12; installed versions and source hashes above control execution.
capability.proof_persistence: Checked source-bound objective cuts survive weight changes. Fresh Glucose proof calls do not retain solver state.
capability.projection_limit: At most16 soft features by default; projection has a separately enforced operation cap. Failure retains checked scalar cuts but returns unresolved reusable support.

comparison_scope: Two conventional persistent native IHS paths with the same RUP bridge and cut projection on the exposed s05 fixture
costs: Common current raw readmission is actual once; both arms then receive identical compact checked banks. Each arm pays own native initialization, objective updates, searches, checking, receipts, and storage. Native CPU/wall/counters are separate from declared Python/DPLL operations; no total cost ranking is asserted.
limitations: Existing source cohort and five recipes are exposed development, not independent validation
Native IHS orchestrator is not optimized iMaxHS; retained MIP model/core rows and explicit starts do not imply branch-tree retention
Fresh RUP proof calls and Boolean objective projection are separately paid; no large-instance scaling evidence
Caps are a disclosed resource vector, not a shared monetary invoice; native memory and monetary cost remain unknown
Cache cell geometry unused; exact pointwise witness/tree projection independently readmitted
